text:
nea.marketing: urgent FYI — spotted a small discrepancy in the benchmark blog we published this morning. Median latency for the 2k token test was reported as 88ms but post-publish re-run shows 108ms for one config.

olivia.pr: Thanks for flagging. Is this a data error in the table or a visualization bug? Need to know if we should alert reporters.

tess.data: digging now. Initial root cause looks like a mis-merged CSV from different run seeds; the charts were generated from a mixed dataset. The full 2k cohort median should be 104-110ms depending on worker batch, not 88ms.

maria.legal: Do we have any contractual claims tied to the 88ms figure? Are any customers referencing it in active deals?
kyle.eng: No contractual promises. Some partners benchmarked off the post earlier but no signed commitments.

maria.legal: ok — still want the correction to be clear and factual. Recommend "correction" language: brief, link to corrected dataset, and a note explaining the nature of the error (aggregation mismatch).

olivia.pr: Agreed. PR preference is transparent correction rather than silent fix because reporters already picked up the original. We'll draft an erratum and send to reporters who asked.

nea.marketing: Timeline? Can eng/data produce corrected graphs and a diffed CSV in 45 minutes?
tess.data: I can regenerate clean runs and produce updated table + CSV in ~30 minutes. I'll include a short note in the dataset README describing the fix.
kyle.eng: I'll re-render images with the corrected numbers and push updated assets to the drive. Expect in 40 minutes.

olivia.pr: I'll draft a short correction email: 1-2 sentences, link to corrected blog + assets, and offer an interview if they need clarification. Want to review language with legal before sending.
maria.legal: send draft here when ready. Keep it limited to the factual correction and avoid forward-looking statements.

supportops: Support team — heads-up we may get inbound questions from customers who saw the 88ms stat. I'm drafting an internal FAQ and escalation path. ETA 30m.

pressbot: [automated] Notifying subscribed reporters is paused pending PR approval.

nea.marketing: Decision checkpoint in 35 minutes. If we can get corrected graph + legal-approved copy, we'll publish the correction on the blog (top of post, red box) and tweet an update. If reporters already published, we'll send the correction email.

olivia.pr: I'll start the reporter list triage — flag ones who have published vs referenced. Please add any new reporters to the doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/bench-erratum 

tess.data: uploaded corrected CSV + run logs to that folder. Filename: bench-2k-corrected-2026-03-23.csv
kyle.eng: updated images uploaded to the same folder, annotated with the commit hash and render time.

maria.legal: Draft correction: "Correction: An earlier version of this post reported an incorrect median latency for the 2,000-token workload due to a dataset aggregation error. The corrected median latency is 108ms (see corrected table and CSV). We apologize for the confusion; corrected assets are linked." Approve?

olivia.pr: I like that. Short + factual. I'll add one line offering to set up technical calls for any reporter who wants deeper detail.

nea.marketing: OK - proceed. Nea will publish erratum box to the blog once legal & data confirm. Please do not send external emails until PR posts the correction and we confirm the reporter list.

pressbot: [automated] Ready to send correction notifications. Awaiting PR trigger.

supportops: Internal FAQ posted in #support-now with bullet points + assigned owners for escalations.

tess.data: final sanity check passed. All run-seed metadata included in the CSV.
kyle.eng: published corrected images to the CDN path with cache-bust. Links in the drive doc.

maria.legal: reviewed final PR copy and approved.

olivia.pr: Sending correction email to the 12 reporters who referenced the figure in ~10 minutes after blog update. I'll paste the email here before send.

nea.marketing: Thanks team. Post-mortem scheduled for tomorrow 11am PT to review pipeline checks and CI guards to prevent merged CSVs.

pressbot: [automated] Action recorded: correction planned, 12 reporters flagged for outreach, assets updated.
